Recorded claim:
Snapshot-only `getWorkingTreeCommits({ diffs: false })` must not invoke per-file `git diff --no-index`: enumerate untracked files once and use tracked diff plus metadata for a change ID. Exact diffs remain on explicit diff paths; `getGraphTryTarget()` reuses that change ID. [Task 2]
